name: com.whathead/ads
title: Whathead Ad Operations
description: Build, edit, transfer and report on ad campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat and 8 more.

com.whathead.authorization: OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration). Bearer tokens for automation clients are minted in the Whathead workspace.
analyticsAndCommerce: Shopify (workspace connection; not yet exposed as MCP tools)
com.whathead.writeSafety: Ad-platform writes default to dry_run: true (Google Tag Manager writes have no dry run); live and destructive actions require explicit confirmation.
com.whathead.readOnlyEndpoint: https://www.whathead.com/mcp/read lists only read-only tools (readOnlyHint: true): the 4 read-only compact tools plus a *_native_read twin of each write-capable gateway. Same OAuth server; tokens without write scopes get the same list on /mcp.
